scope: Native single-CPU Linux; software TLB range invalidation; Mac only; product defaults unchanged

lkl-translation-tlb-final.scope: Native single-CPU LKL with translated ARM64 userspace; selected workload only; iPhone unverified
lkl-translation-tlb-final.measurement: Guest clock times 128 pipe round trips per memory case; excludes initial COW materialization. Selected preemption, translation and selected Linux mapping implementation included. Memory means are arithmetic sample means, including phase boundaries; sampled peaks can miss short peaks. Resident lifetime peak is separate.

android-translation-tlb-matrix.scope: Same executable, system image and DEX; balanced configuration order
